parameters.query:
SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status, u.age,
       json_agg(json_build_object(
         'product_name', p.product_name,
         'bank_name', p.bank_name,
         'interest_rate_min', p.interest_rate_min,
         'max_loan_amount', p.max_loan_amount,
         'processing_fee', p.processing_fee,
         'eligibility_score', m.eligibility_score,
         'match_reasons', m.match_reasons,
         'ai_recommendation', m.ai_recommendation
       ) ORDER BY m.eligibility_score DESC) as matches
FROM users u
JOIN matches m ON u.user_id = m.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON m.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE m.notified = FALSE OR m.notified IS NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status, u.age
LIMIT 10;
